technical-summary: RUM04 C45 exposes native_config_view(const Manifest&) from the shared strict reader. It returns the admitted immutable YAML bytes and snapshot digest/root for any validated role, including unmeasured measuring manifests, without requiring EngineMemory. The isolated real-v3-writer test verifies exact snapshot identity through the accessor for both measuring and serving outputs after authored-file removal.
user-summary-candidate: The strict manifest reader now exposes the same admitted native YAML snapshot for both measuring and serving roles, and the isolated v3 writer test verifies both.
